note: Unified execution roadmap aligned with locked ADRs. This roadmap merges the historical 20-phase plan with the ADR-governed execution model. Completed phases are preserved, pending phases are shifted or merged, and out-of-scope phases are removed.

phases.title: Bootstrap & Governance
phases.summary: Project foundation, resolver, exceptions, CI, base governance.

phases.title: Base Repository Layer
phases.summary: BaseRepository and adapter-specific bases with validation and logging.

phases.title: Generic CRUD (Minimal)
phases.summary: Minimal CRUD across MySQL, Mongo, Redis without advanced querying.

phases.title: Redis Safety Enforcement
phases.summary: Strict Redis behavior: SCAN-only, safety limits, fail-fast guards.

phases.title: Interface Segregation (Read / Write)
phases.summary: Split repository contracts into read and write interfaces.

phases.title: SQL Identifier Quoting Consistency
phases.summary: Centralize and enforce SQL identifier quoting across all operations.

phases.title: MongoDB Explicit Behavior
phases.summary: Explicit ObjectId casting and MongoOps alignment.

phases.title: Pagination & Count Semantics
phases.summary: Unified pagination, count behavior, and DTO guarantees.

phases.title: Hydration Lifecycle Enforcement
phases.summary: Hydration pipeline, auto-casting, DTO mapping as locked contract.

phases.title: Error, Logging & Observability Boundaries
phases.summary: Exception taxonomy and safe logging boundaries.

phases.title: Fake vs Real Adapter Parity
phases.summary: Guarantee identical behavior across fake and real adapters.

phases.title: Documentation & Philosophy
phases.summary: Public documentation explaining scope, safety, and philosophy.

phases.title: Release & Stability Lock
phases.summary: Final tests, changelog, tagging, Packagist publish.
